about: What a change of value may start. A field's change runs with no tap: it may change what the screen shows and may send the form the field stands in (a filter that sends itself), and nothing else. Copying, another form, going to an address, a request of its own and a device call happen only from a tap; each kind refused is said once.

steps.note: The app starts and asks for its shell.
